goal: Improve LANS honestly; no rank-one guarantee or post-hoc outcome selection.
fixed: magnitude parameters m1650 Iz4224 lf1.2 lr1.4 Cf/Cr80000
selection: Within each controller family, select one whole configuration across all three training seeds by mean validation completion fraction, then mean penalized RMSE; no per-scenario or best-seed switching. Test is executed once after selection file exists.
training: Four known reference families with randomized amplitude/time scale and mass; delay curriculum uses 0ms first25%, 0/10ms next25%, and0/10/20/50/100/200ms plus mixed last50%.
validation: All four nominal reference families, none/mixed/fixed200, nominal mass plus DLC1100/2200; same plant/actuator/queue/reference information for every method.
test: Fresh physical seeds and held-out reference amplitude/time scaling factors(.9,1.1). Reference families were included in training, so no unseen-family generalization claim.
baselines: LQR and MPC retain previous fixed gains/horizon; PPO receives same feature transformation,reward,curriculum,seed/step budget and two configuration trials. Any comparison with LQR/MPC is explicitly against those settings, not all possible tuned baselines.
metrics: Completion and failure-penalized RMSE from previous campaign. Family selection uses all seeds; final rankings of means are not universal dominance claims.
integrity: Original results,manuscript and checkpoints are not overwritten.
